comment: The Tag Cloud page end to end, after scripts/tagcloud-probe.mjs seeded the sandbox: the Library tools link, the packed cloud, a word's titles, narrowing, the words slider, the settings panel (Rows and back), a saved cloud, the full-screen view and Esc. It deletes the cloud it saved and leaves the look as it found it.

steps.name: Library tools links the Tag Cloud
clear the look of earlier runs
the page as drawn
steps.script: var words = Array.prototype.map.call(document.querySelectorAll('.jftc-page-body .jftc-svg text.jftc-word'), function (t) { return t.textContent; }); return { title: document.title, words: words.length, summary: document.querySelector('.jftc-summary').textContent, sources: Array.prototype.map.call(document.querySelectorAll('.jftc-seg')[0].children, function (b) { return b.textContent; }), header: Array.prototype.map.call(document.querySelectorAll('.jftc-card-actions button'), function (b) { return b.textContent; }) };

steps.message: the six sources, in the toolbar's order

steps.name: click a word
steps.script: var t = document.querySelector('.jftc-page-body .jftc-svg text.jftc-word[role=button]'); window.__clicked = t.getAttribute('data-key'); t.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', { bubbles: true })); return window.__clicked;

steps.message: the selection is in the hash

steps.name: right-click a word narrows the cloud
steps.script: var t = document.querySelector('.jftc-page-body .jftc-svg text.jftc-word[role=button]'); t.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('contextmenu', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true })); return t.getAttribute('data-key');

steps.name: Show all
steps.script: Array.prototype.filter.call(document.querySelectorAll('.jftc-narrowing button'), function (b) { return b.textContent === 'Show all'; })[0].click(); return true;

steps.name: the words slider to 25
steps.script: var r = document.querySelector('.jftc-words'); r.value = '25'; r.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); return r.max + '/' + r.step;

steps.name: the cloud shows the words asked for
Rows
steps.script: var s = document.querySelector('.jftc-settings select[aria-label="Arrangement"]'); s.value = 'Flow'; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return true;

steps.name: back to Cloud, and Done
steps.script: var s = document.querySelector('.jftc-settings select[aria-label="Arrangement"]'); s.value = 'Packed'; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); Array.prototype.filter.call(document.querySelectorAll('.jftc-settings-actions button'), function (b) { return b.textContent === 'Done'; })[0].click(); return true;

steps.name: open Save cloud
steps.script: Array.prototype.filter.call(document.querySelectorAll('.jftc-saved button'), function (b) { return /Save cloud/.test(b.textContent); })[0].click(); return true;

steps.name: Save
steps.script: Array.prototype.filter.call(document.querySelectorAll('.jftc-settings-actions button'), function (b) { return b.textContent === 'Save'; })[0].click(); return true;

steps.name: its pill shows, as the current cloud
Full screen
steps.script: Array.prototype.filter.call(document.querySelectorAll('.jftc-card-actions button'), function (b) { return /Full screen/.test(b.textContent); })[0].click(); return true;

steps.name: the full-screen view covers the window with the cloud alone
steps.waitFor: (function () { var v = document.querySelector('.jftc-show'); if (!v || v.querySelectorAll('.jftc-svg text.jftc-word').length === 0) return false; var r = v.getBoundingClientRect(); return r.width >= innerWidth - 1 && r.height >= innerHeight - 1 && /show=1/.test(location.hash) && v.querySelectorAll('.jftc-toolbar, .jftc-saved').length === 0; })()

steps.message: no toast over the full-screen view

steps.name: the exit button and pointer hide when idle
clean up: the saved cloud and the look
steps.script: return ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('TagCloud/Clouds')).then(function (list) { return Promise.all(list.filter(function (x) { return x.IsMine && x.Name === 'Webcheck cloud'; }).map(function (x) { return ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'DELETE', url: ApiClient.getUrl('TagCloud/Clouds/' + x.Id) }); })); }).then(function () { return ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('TagCloud/Clouds')); }).then(function (left) { localStorage.removeItem('jftc:look'); return left.filter(function (x) { return x.IsMine; }).length; });
